items.title: 英偉達在黃仁勳離職後的首份財報中業績和預期均超乎預期：即時更新
items.titleEn: Nvidia beats on results and guidance in first earnings report since Huang's exit: Live updates
items.titleZh: 英偉達在黃仁勳離職後的首份財報中業績和預期均超乎預期：即時更新
items.summaryEn: Nvidia released fiscal third-quarter 2027 results on Tuesday, with its earnings call scheduled for 5 p.m. ET.
items.summaryZh: 英偉達於週二發布了 2027 財年第三季業績報告，財報電話會議定於美國東部時間下午 5 點舉行。

items.title: 受家得寶股價拖累，道瓊斯期貨下跌200點；交易員等待英偉達財報：即時更新
items.titleEn: Dow futures slide 200 points weighed by Home Depot; traders await Nvidia earnings: Live updates
items.titleZh: 受家得寶股價拖累，道瓊斯期貨下跌200點；交易員等待英偉達財報：即時更新
items.summaryEn: Nvidia shares pulled back 4.1%, as traders dumped the chipmaker ahead of its fiscal third-quarter report, due Tuesday after the bell
items.summaryZh: 英偉達股價下跌4.1%，交易員在該公司週二盤後公佈第三財季財報前拋售其股票。

items.title: 英偉達領跌人工智慧股，股指期貨下跌：即時更新
items.titleEn: Stock futures slide as Nvidia leads AI stocks lower: Live updates
items.titleZh: 英偉達領跌人工智慧股，股指期貨下跌：即時更新
items.summaryEn: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted their biggest weekly gains since August, rising more than 2% each.
items.summaryZh: 道瓊指數、標普500指數和那斯達克指數均錄得8月以來最大單週漲幅，漲幅均超過2%。

items.title: Megaspeed表示，Alice Huang將於2025年離職，同時該公司已對有關其業務的報告展開內部調查。
items.titleEn: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 as it launches internal probe into reports about its business
items.titleZh: Megaspeed表示，Alice Huang將於2025年離職，同時該公司已對有關其業務的報告展開內部調查。
items.summaryEn: The Singapore-based cloud computing company has faced heightened scrutiny since reports linked Nvidia's Jensen Huang to former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
items.summaryZh: 自從有通報稱英偉達的黃仁勳與前Megaspeed高層黃愛麗有染後，這家總部位於新加坡的雲端運算公司就面臨更嚴格的審查。

items.title: 美國聯邦航空管理局下令停止地面航班後，美國航班已恢復，但旅行中斷情況仍然存在。
items.titleEn: U.S. flights resume after FAA ground stop, but travel disruption continues
items.titleZh: 美國聯邦航空管理局下令停止地面航班後，美國航班已恢復，但旅行中斷情況仍然存在。
items.summaryEn: U.S. flights are resuming after the FAA ground stop, but delays and cancellations are still piling up.
items.summaryZh: 美國聯邦航空管理局下令停飛後，美國航班正在逐步恢復，但延誤和取消的情況仍然不斷增加。

items.title: 10月批發價格上漲0.3%，年化物價漲幅達6.5%，為近四年來最高水準。
items.titleEn: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
items.titleZh: 10月批發價格上漲0.3%，年化物價漲幅達6.5%，為近四年來最高水準。
items.summaryEn: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.4% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊共識預測，10月份生產者物價指數預計將上漲0.4%。
